name: The Catholic Church
overview: Scripture reveals foundational truths about the church, beginning with Christ's declaration to Peter that He would build His church upon this rock, promising that the gates of hell would not prevail against it. The Great Commission commands believers to disciple all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, emphasizing the centrality of Christ and the gospel. However, Scripture also warns against elevating human traditions above God's Word, as such practices can nullify its power. Furthermore, believers are reminded to honor God alone as Father in heaven, underscoring a Christ-centered and God-glorifying approach to church life.
